findings.claim_text: White House OSTP Director Michael Kratsios accuses Moonshot AI of 'large-scale, covert industrial distillation' of Anthropic's Fable model to build Kimi K3, distinguishing it from 'legitimate' small-scale distillation
NVIDIA itself holds a reported $10B equity stake in Anthropic
Within 24 hours the list doubled to 50 names, adding OpenAI, Google and AMD. Two firms never showed up: Amazon, and its biggest AI holding, Anthropic.
